note: Cross-surface FEATURE-INTENT registry. One row = one product feature, keyed by intent, not by spelling — the same feature legitimately carries different code names per surface (wire INGEST vs UI 장기대여; workspaceId that means creator workspace). Rationale and usage rules live in the sibling contracts/feature-map.md. Gate: scripts/verify-feature-map.py resolves each surface's repo as a sibling checkout (../<repo> relative to this repo; 'Agentlas-OS' is this repo itself), requires the file to exist and to contain the identifier verbatim (rename alarm, not semantics proof), and prints an honest SKIP when a sibling checkout is absent. 'kind' is one of code|endpoint|screen|method|table|wireId. 'identifier' must be the EXACT symbol/route/table/string as it exists in the file today. Alias status: wire-legacy (still on the wire, name is historical), retired (must not reappear in new copy), display (user-facing label, translated per surface).

intent.ko: 허브 에이전트 호출은 작업(work order) 1건당 RENT 크레딧을 매번 과금한다 — 24시간 자동 리스는 폐지(오너 결정 2026-08-18).
intent.en: Every Hub agent call bills RENT credits per work order, on every call; the 24-hour auto-lease is retired (owner decision 2026-08-18).

surfaces.meaning: Canonical price-kind table. RENT: per work order, recurring, ceiling 100 credits; the unit token stays the legacy literal WORK_ORDER_24H because clients parse it.
Charge path: every runtime call resolves priceKind RENT and commits the wallet charge + ledger payload in one transaction before the bundle is released.
Desktop mirror of the wire price-kind union RENT|INGEST|FORK.
Flash notice: per-work-order estimated cost shown for 8s before a paid auto-hire, suppressed only when every hub hire is rent-allowed or day-leased.
Terminal notice before public Hub calls: credits are consumed per work order, 0 while a day lease is active.
Mobile shows the per-call estimated credits next to the agent's source label.

aliases.note: RENT's unit token predates the auto-lease retirement; a charge no longer opens a 24h window.

aliases.name: 24시간 자동 리스
aliases.note: Retired 2026-08-18; must not reappear in new copy.

aliases.name: 빌리기 / Rent · 작업 1건당 / per work order

intent.ko: 선불 일 단위 장기대여 — 대여 기간 중 그 에이전트 호출은 0크레딧이며, 와이어 id INGEST는 레거시 표기다.
intent.en: Prepaid per-day long-term lease of one agent; calls cost 0 credits while active. The wire id INGEST is legacy spelling.

surfaces.meaning: Unit token for the INGEST price kind: one agent for one day, ceiling 2000 credits/day.
POST /api/account/agent-leases buys/extends a lease (priceKind INGEST via commitNetworkEconomyCharge); GET quotes/lists leases.
Web lease domain logic (per-day pricing and lease windows).
Web purchase entry point on marketplace/agent pages.
Desktop client of the agent-leases endpoints, with the lease cache the rent gate reads.
Desktop lease/extend dialog (일 단위 선불 대여).
Mobile price-setting copy for the per-day lease (1–2,000 credits/day).

aliases.name: INGEST
aliases.note: Wire price-kind id; kept because clients parse it. New copy must say 장기대여 / long-term lease.

aliases.name: 프로젝트 인제스트
aliases.note: Old product framing (project ingest). Still literally present in Agentlas-OS agentlas_cloud/pricing.py PRICE_LABELS — stale copy, do not propagate.

intent.ko: 포크 = 허브 에이전트 사본을 1회 구매해 내 워크스페이스 소유로 설치한다; 획득은 웹 단일 진입점이고 사본은 출처 계보(lineage)를 영구히 지닌다.
intent.en: A fork is a one-time purchase of a Hub agent copy installed into the buyer's workspace; acquisition is web-only, and the copy carries its origin lineage forever.

surfaces.meaning: The ONLY acquisition path (owner decision: one entry point so lineage cannot be forgotten). Charges priceKind FORK via commitNetworkEconomyCharge and stamps the origin at install time.
Web buy-a-copy button.
Lineage record: originPackageHash is load-bearing; originOwnerUserId makes forked self-calls detectable.
Desktop refusal: a folder carrying fork lineage cannot be published to the public Hub; saves carry the lineage forward.
Reads the local restore marker whose .fork field is the desktop-side source of the lineage refusals.

aliases.name: install
aliases.note: Web UI says install; the wire price kind is FORK, unit ONE_COPY.

intent.ko: 프로젝트별로 '이 Hub 에이전트를 고지 없이 작업당 자동 고용해도 된다'는 명시적 동의를 (projectId × slug)로 기록한다 — 행이 없으면 기본 OFF, 자동 고용 후보에서 제외.
intent.en: Per-project explicit consent (projectId × slug) that a Hub agent may be auto-hired per work order without a per-send notice; no row means OFF and the agent is excluded from auto-hire.

surfaces.meaning: SQLite table added in migration v97 (appended to the ladder end), PK (project_id, slug), allowed default 0.
Store module; slugs are lowercased so lookups match the lease cache. Explicit user calls (/hep-call, @mention) are NOT gated here.
Main-process gate: a Hub spec passes if rent-allowed in this project, day-leased, or explicitly named.
Composer filter: non-allowed hub agents are dropped from the auto-hire preview; cost notice suppressed only when every kept hub hire is allowed or leased.

intent.ko: 모든 MCP 호출의 최소 메타데이터 원장 — 크리에이터 수익배분과 공개 신뢰 랭킹의 근거이며, 자기호출은 랭킹에서 제외된다.
intent.en: Minimal-metadata ledger of every MCP call — the basis for creator revenue share and public trust rankings, with self-calls excluded from ranking.

surfaces.meaning: Mongo collection (store key invocationLedger), receiptId-keyed with an outbox retry so lost rows don't undercount creators.

FIELD MEANINGS — callerId: caller workspace identity ('mcp-anonymous' when unauthenticated). creatorId: agent creator's workspace. workspaceId: CURRENTLY ALSO the creator workspace, NOT the caller — writer quirk, see recordLedger. Readers must not treat workspaceId as the caller.
The writer: sets BOTH workspaceId and creatorId to profile.workspaceId (creator). This quirk is why the reader-side self-call rule uses one comparison only.
Consumer. Self-call exclusion is exactly callerId ≠ creatorId; the old second condition workspaceId ≠ creatorId was removed because the writer stores the same value in both.
Consumer, same self-call rule; non-public sourceScope fails closed out of public trust.

aliases.name: invocationLedger
aliases.note: In-code store key for the invocation_ledger collection.

intent.ko: 모바일에서 데스크탑 브리지를 통해 내 에이전트를 허브에 공개 발행하고 가격을 설정한다 — hub-publish-v1 호스트 능력이 있을 때만 제공한다.
intent.en: Mobile publishes the user's agent to the public Hub and sets prices through the desktop bridge — offered only when the host advertises the hub-publish-v1 capability.

surfaces.meaning: Bridge method (with cloud.setHubPrices) in the production allowlist; validators bound prices to RENT/INGEST/FORK.
Host-side handlers executing the publish and price patch with desktop authority.
Capability advertisement. Older Desktops advertise only cloud-agent-actions; Mobile must not offer publishing against them.
Contract doc: exactly 60 methods including 30 writes; Hub publish methods gated on hub-publish-v1. A pricing failure after a committed publish is never a failed publish.
Typed result models for the publish and price-set replies.

intent.ko: 두 계좌 크레딧 잔액 조회 — 구독 계좌(A) remainingCredits(사용 가능)와 렌트수익 계좌(B) earningsCredits(내 업로드가 벌어들인 몫), 전송은 B→A 한 방향.
intent.en: Two-account credit balance: subscription account (A) remainingCredits, spendable, and rental-earnings account (B) earningsCredits; transfers flow B→A only.

surfaces.meaning: GET /api/billing/credits — the single source every surface reads.
Desktop main-process reader (cached ~60s); the paywall and mobile projection both consume it.
Read-only bridge method exposing the balance to Mobile.
agentlas billing command; honest exit 1 on auth failure — never fakes a 0 balance.
Transport constant for the billing.credits RPC; client mirrors the 60s re-ask cadence.
